#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<int> bal(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        bal[i] = (i == 0 ? 0 : bal[i - 1]) + (a[i] % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }

    vector<int> diffs;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (bal[i] == 0) {
            diffs.push_back(abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]));
        }
    }

    sort(diffs.begin(), diffs.end());

    int ans = 0;
    for (int d : diffs) {
        if (b >= d) {
            b -= d;
            ++ans;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
